scoring_justification: Check relative error of each computed tensor component from agent's CSV against hidden paper-digitized gold values; recompute metric from raw artifact.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold values for effective elasticity tensor components at four cell-wall angles
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig. 10 digitized values (converted to MPa)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Digitized from published figure using WebPlotDigitizer, then converted to engineering units.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported results; reproducing them requires correct analytical homogenization.

outputs.description: Nine independent components of the effective elasticity tensor for each cell wall angle.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker compares each value to paper-reported gold values digitized from Fig. 10, scoring via relative error with full credit within 5% tolerance. The 9 components are C1111, C2222, C1122, C1133, C2233, C3333, C1212, C1313, C2323.
